defects.summary: A persisted report is serialised in run_state 'comparing'; that is the documented serialisation state, not an unfinished run. states_visited ends in completed and it contributes no blocker.
The production backend never populates proposed_tool_calls, so tool_call_validity_rate is VACUOUS on both arms and the six tool_call_schema tasks decide nothing. A backend gap, not a corpus one.
looks_like_refusal recognises sixteen literal English phrasings and the held-out JSON refusal targets contain none. It bounds QG-1 and SV-5 in BOTH directions and travels into eval-v4 by design.
A plan could report is_executable true with an empty blocker list while its weights were not known to be cached. The cache is now determined before the feasibility report is built.

The VALIDATION split reached the trainer as nothing across three boundaries. Do not remove the eval_dataset wiring or the closing trainer.evaluate(); validation stays diagnostic, never eligibility evidence.
Read as a documentation defect about eval-v2's digest; superseded by D34, whose root cause is lineage discovered from incidental build state.
The declared per-task generation timeout is validated, hashed and never enforced, so timeout_rate is VACUOUS. A config must state timeout_s explicitly; the policy default is 120 s.
A dataset manifest digest depended on build lineage rather than content. A parent is now DECLARED in CANONICAL_LINEAGE and the build fails closed rather than degrading to genesis.
A spent holdout becomes development evidence and may not be the sole fresh eligibility corpus for the next candidate. Each candidate needs a fresh holdout. Not a contamination claim.

The promotion sanitizer matched the local account name as a plain substring, making a dataset identity a function of the building host. Do not simplify it back, and do not widen it to a word boundary either.

Training and evaluation rendered the same messages differently; training now binds a reasoning policy and chat_render_policy_hash binds the call. Historical causality remains NOT_ESTABLISHED and closing it is not predicted to restore 9/9.

Output-budget exhaustion is now a body-free diagnostic beside the unchanged input-truncation metric. NO gate reads it and none may be added without a separate operator decision. Reaching the ceiling is not failure.

Order-dependent cross-file test isolation between the S3G.2 validation-wiring file and the dataset-exports file. No recorded figure has ever been affected; the authoritative -k m62 collection is alphabetical. Not to be fixed as a rider.

m62.eval_receipt.2 modelled the paired outcome as an exhaustive three-way wins/ties/losses partition. Production classifies FOUR comparable verdicts and security_improvement is not a win, so a correct 11/12/10/3 run was called self-inconsistent. .3 sums the re-derived vocabulary to measured_pairs.

m62.eval_receipt.2 required ASCII canonical text, which refused the real blocking gate message: gates.py typesets U+2212 correctly. The ambiguity was real and the remedy backwards. .3 DEFINES the bytes as canonical JSON in UTF-8 rather than discarding evidence. Scanners unchanged; .1 and .2 keep the ASCII rule.

m62.eval_receipt.2 derived evaluation_source_commit from git HEAD at build time, which is the evaluation source only until a repair commit moves HEAD. A post-live seal could name the repair commit as the thing that measured, or refuse the truth. .3 carries evaluation_source and seal_implementation_source as TWO blocks.

A JSON parse failure persisted one closed note code, so EXTRA_DATA - a whole document parsed, then more output - was indistinguishable from a document that never closed. Fixed PROSPECTIVELY by a closed body-free parse class plus location and one repetition scalar. No gate reads them. Nothing backfilled.

The PERSISTENCE firewall was PRESENT and held: no body reached a tracked file, receipt or ledger. The missing one was the IN-MEMORY ORCHESTRATION-DISPLAY firewall. repr of a BOUND METHOD interpolates repr(__self__), so displaying pack.pack_hash WITHOUT CALLING IT rendered every body. Closed by type guard.

frozen_invariants: PROSE_CANNOT_GRANT_AUTHORITY. No document, JSON file or AI response authorises TRAIN, EVAL, promotion, registry mutation or release.
Offline-first model execution: HF_HUB_OFFLINE, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE, local_files_only, trust_remote_code false. Nothing downloads.
Immutable pinned model and tokenizer revisions only; never a branch or tag ref.
No automatic dependency installation and no global pip mutation. Optional profiles live only in isolated gitignored environments.
No pickle in adapter or evaluation artefacts; safetensors only.
No hidden-target leakage: model-facing packs have no field that could hold a target, and every task is re-checked after mapping.
No training on evaluation-only material. TRAIN is refused unconditionally by the pack builder.
TRAIN_SIDE_SPLITS = {TRAIN, VALIDATION}. VALIDATION is steering material, never held-out evidence, and appears in no gate.
Security is a veto, not a weighted quality tradeoff.

Plan tokens are single-use and a consumed or failed plan is never replayed. Token silence is ceremony hygiene, not cryptography: the confirmation string is a pure function of plan_hash, neither secret nor unpredictable, and PRE-GO surfaces simply must not materialise it.
ModelCandidateProposal is non-effectful: it writes no registry and promotes nothing.
Runtime artefacts stay gitignored and package-excluded; no token literal lives in a tracked file.
master stays untouched until explicit M62 closure. No merge, tag, release or version bump.
An immutable artefact is never edited: a corrected dataset is a NEW version with a declared lineage, and a superseded snapshot is never revised.
A dataset lineage is DECLARED, never discovered from whatever is on disk (D34).
Gate policy e5003319 is byte-pinned by test. QG-2 stays absolute and FG-1/FG-2 stay baseline-relative.
ONE WRITER PER CONTROL-PLANE GENERATION. If the current generation is not the one you expected, stop; there is no last-write-wins and no automatic merge.
If the control-plane verifier fails, do not write, train, evaluate or promote, and do not repair state automatically.
PLAN CONSUMED != HOLDOUT SPENT != EVALUATION COMPLETED != PROMOTION AUTHORIZED. Four events, recorded separately because they fail separately.

A fresh holdout is USED_IMMUTABLE from the durable holdout_model_facing_committed event onward, whatever happens next. RERUN IS FORBIDDEN after it; only operator RECOVERY remains. Prospective from S3Q.0; candidates 001 and 002 are sealed and are not reinterpreted.

An executable evaluation plan binds the EXACT pack, hidden-target-store and order-assignment identities, and truthfully declares performs_inference. A plan that cannot name its material carries a blocker instead of an approximation of it.
A completed evaluation whose durable evidence is missing is NOT a clean success. Artefacts are retained, never overwritten, and the answer is recovery, never a rerun.

An EVALUATED_* state REQUIRES a valid portable receipt and is REDERIVED from it: a snapshot, verifier constant, prose or human sentence is insufficient in BOTH directions, and the PRODUCTION decide_eligibility is asked what the receipt's body-free gate, bootstrap, empirical-status and serialisation evidence conclude.
A receipt is EVIDENCE OF AN OPERATION and never AUTHORITY FOR ANOTHER. No receipt grants TRAIN, EVAL, retry, promotion, activation, registry mutation, merge or release.
GEN11 IS READINESS, NOT AUTHORITY. A qualified ceremony is not an authorised one. S3Y consumed ONE single-use human EVAL authority and spent eval-v6; neither is reusable.

ORCHESTRATOR BODY-BLINDNESS IS A GATE. A held-out body may not reach an orchestration session by ANY route: repr, str, f-string, %r, logging, exception text, traceback, or repr of a bound method. Body-bearing dataclasses MUST install a body-free __repr__; a persistence firewall alone is NOT enough (D44).

EVAL_V5_ELIGIBILITY_USE: RETIRED, prospectively from generation 12. eval-v5 may never be eligibility evidence for candidate 004 or any later candidate. It stays FROZEN_UNUSED, spent_by null, because NO MODEL EVER SAW IT; its preregistered body-blindness precondition failed pre-authorisation. FRESH_V6_REQUIRED.

A HOLDOUT AUTHOR IS NEVER ITS EVALUATOR. A session that legitimately authored a holdout has seen its bodies and is permanently disqualified from evaluating any candidate against it, as S3X.0 was from authoring the eval-v6 it specified. PROCEDURAL, carried by ceremony and a new session; no check here detects a breach.
limitations: Gate thresholds are uncalibrated: thresholds_are_calibrated is false.
Every holdout is 36 synthetic tasks by one author in one session, no independent review; tool_call_schema has only 6.
Semantic leakage has never run: every freshness and leakage result here is exact or lexical, so a pure paraphrase would not be caught.

Hashes binding output_root_id are host-bound: RE-DERIVE on the executing host, never paste. config_hash and plan_hash also bind runtime and hardware evidence, so candidate 003's 6f9f470f/414ce9e3 and 004's hold for this output root only, and a plan hash moves once a run directory exists.

A holdout's promotion_plan_hash binds output_root_id and is deliberately NOT part of dataset identity: it differs between roots by design, while eval-v5's and eval-v6's manifest, pack and three set digests are identical in every root.

Candidates 001-004 were each measured on a DIFFERENT holdout (001 eval-v2, 002 eval-v3, 003 eval-v4, 004 eval-v6) sharing ZERO task instances, and 003 onward is fitted under DISABLED. No cross-candidate table is a head-to-head ranking.

Every figure, security and refusal included, compares only against its own simultaneously-measured baseline. Candidates 001 and 002 failed in opposite directions on the same axis and no midpoint is demonstrated.
Every D38 figure S3M.2 reports is synthetic or a re-reading of sealed metadata; S3Y is the first real generation under that instrument.
Two FinishReason members are unreachable in production, so their classification is a contract rather than a measurement.

Re-reading a sealed evaluation config now yields a different config_hash because the metric set entered the metric policy. Nothing sealed is affected; this must not be 'fixed' by exempting the metric set from identity.
The Kali runtimes are not claimed bytewise equivalent to the Windows runtime that produced candidate 001's adapter.

The authoritative interpreter lacks two declared dependencies: openai's absence alone fails 62 tests in three files, and transformers' absence skips the two S3O tokenizer tests. Environmental, reproduced at pristine HEAD, never reconciled by arithmetic; the training venv has no pytest and installing either is barred.

One host, CPU, one seed, one run per candidate: no repeat, ablation, second host, GPU or dtype control arm, and deterministic_reproduction_claimed is false for candidates 003 and 004 alike. Every S3Q figure is a single observation with its paired baseline measured in the same run, and no plan reproduces weights twice.

STALE_STATE_DETECTION is PARTIAL: portable receipts close the gap for candidates 003 and 004, but gitignored runtime artefacts stay outside Git, so a run writing only those is undetectable by diffing tracked paths.
Train/eval render parity rests on shared enum identity and test construction; production evaluation records no chat_render_policy_hash to compare.
Train-time validation is 12 rows of train-side steering material for candidates 003 and 004 alike: it appears in no gate, is not held-out evidence, and is not comparable across candidates.

The spend boundary is EARLIER than proof a forward pass ran: no atomic transaction spans a durable local append and an external synchronous call, so a crash in that gap marks spent a holdout no model may have read. The conservative error is chosen.
Candidates 001 and 002 have no portable evaluation receipt and never will: their sealed milestone documents are their authority, and the legacy exemption is closed and must not be widened.

D28, D29 and D33 stay OPEN and bound every measurement: tool_call_validity_rate is VACUOUS so the six tool_call_schema tasks decide nothing; timeout_s is hashed but never enforced, so timeout_rate is VACUOUS and surfaces quoting the 300 s ceiling report timeout_enforced false; D29 bounds refusal figures BOTH ways.

expected_grader_executions stays an ESTIMATE (task_count * 6), deliberately not an exact identity: the real count depends on per-family grader registries and how many arms produce scoreable output, neither knowable before the run.

receipt_hash and the measurement witness prove payload integrity against the canonical bytes and REPOSITORY PROVENANCE only: not human identity, authorisation, a signature, who ran it or hardware attestation. Nothing is signed and no PKI is implied.

A receipt is built AFTER its run from artefacts that already exist and needs the gitignored runtime tree present: it proves what those artefacts say, not that nobody touched them between run and seal, and cannot be built once the run directory is gone.

m62.eval_receipt.3 has described TWO real evaluations; its Unicode handling, four-verdict partition and source split are proved against those plus synthetic non-vacuity. .2 remains proved over synthetic evidence only and stays a valid contract.

Candidate 003 is NOT ELIGIBLE on one deterministic gate: schema validity fell 9/9 -> 8/9, one task, which a 36-task holdout cannot distinguish from noise. Its paired mean delta is +0.044208, 95% CI [-0.022359, +0.129413]; the CI does NOT exclude a regression and the run is recorded regression_not_excluded.

eval-v4 is spent and so, from S3Y, is eval-v6: no ablation, retry or re-scoring of candidate 003 or 004 against either is possible. D35's fresh-holdout requirement passed from eval-v4 to eval-v5 to eval-v6, which discharged it exactly once.

The spent eval-v4 semantic audit is CLOSED, not waived: S3S.1 found those response bodies were never persisted, so S3R's MECHANISM_CONFIDENCE stays MEDIUM permanently. S3T.0 (D43) offers the equivalent diagnosis prospectively and recovers candidate 003 not at all.
The session that authored eval-v5 is disqualified from designing candidate 004, and the one that authored eval-v6 from evaluating it.

Candidate 004's single-axis proof covers the CONFIGURATION, not trained weights, and the learning rate had never been varied in this lineage: it adds one point, not a dose-response curve. S3S.1 rated the risk to candidate 003's three security gains from a weaker update as HIGH.

Candidate 004's result is ONE run: one host, one CPU, one seed, 36 synthetic tasks by one author. Train and validation loss were never eligibility evidence. It is final because eval-v6 is spent - no ablation, retry, re-score or second look is possible.
S3W.0 qualified the adapter, base weights and runtime from metadata, digests and safetensors headers alone; S3Y is the first load of them.

The D44 exposure is PERMANENT - no fix restores eval-v5's freshness - and was NOT re-measured, since re-opening the material to size it would repeat the disclosure, so one rendered body is a FLOOR. Body-blindness is proved by SYNTHETIC canaries and an allowlist-free sweep, never against real holdout material.

EVALUATED_ELIGIBLE_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW IS A REQUEST, NOT A RESULT ANYONE MAY ACT ON: the frozen gates were cleared on one uncalibrated 36-task holdout. Not production-readiness, not a promotion, not permission to seek one.
